findings.title: Embedded post author link light-theme color changed from 30% to 70%
findings.body: This rule was previously `color: scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)`. The replacement uses `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%))`, so light themes now get a 70% tint instead of the original 30% tint. That makes the embedded-post author link much lighter and lower-contrast in light themes. It should likely be `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%))`.

findings.title: Group member name light-theme color changed from 30% to 50%
findings.body: This rule was previously `color: scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)`. The new value uses `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%)` for light themes, which makes group member names noticeably lighter and reduces contrast. The original 30% value should be preserved for light themes, with the dark theme branch using `scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%)`.

findings.title: Custom message length hint color inverted in light theme
findings.body: This rule was previously `color: scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%)`, but the replacement uses `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)` for light themes and `scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%)` for dark themes. This makes the hint text much darker in light themes and is inconsistent with the desktop conversion, which uses 70% primary / 30% secondary. It should likely be `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%))`.

findings.title: Topic map h3 light-theme color changed from 20% to 50%
findings.body: This rule was previously `color: scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%)`. The replacement uses `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%)` for light themes, weakening the header emphasis. The desktop counterpart was converted to 20% primary / 80% secondary. This should likely be `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 80%))`.

findings.title: Group member name light-theme color changed from 30% to 50%
findings.body: This rule was previously `color: scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)`. The new value uses `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%)` for light themes, making group member names lighter and reducing contrast. The original 30% value should be preserved for light themes, with the dark theme branch using `scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%)`.

findings.title: Missed dark-theme conversion for category badge notification color
findings.body: This selector still uses `color: scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%)` directly, unlike the nearby th/td/topic-excerpt rules changed in this PR. In dark themes, category badge notification text will still use the primary-only value and remain inconsistent with the rest of the converted topic list. It should use `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%))`.
